level_1_description: Decisions are made by a single party, without clear possibility for the community to participate.
level_2_description: Governance is shared by multiple parties, and there is an advisory board or similar to represent the community.
level_3_description: The governance is in the hands of a consortium or board that represents well the main stakeholders and user groups.
level_4_description: Full community participation in the governance through mechanisms like elections and self governance.
